ADVISORY COMMISSION ON AGING AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, APRIL 8, 2026
  1150 E. 4TH STREET
  LONG BEACH SENIOR CENTER, ROOM 202, 10:00 AM

Judi Clarke, Chair  Clarice Kavanaugh, Commissioner
Sylvia Salcedo, Vice Chair  Phyllis Schmidt, Commissioner
Norma Chinchilla, Commissioner  Harold Sutherland, Commissioner
Carolyn Hines, Commissioner

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to
  Heidi.Mazas@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54829  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Advisory Commission on Aging meeting
  of Wednesday, March 11, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-54830  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the Design Update at the new
  Senior Center located at 125 Elm Avenue from Public Works.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-54831  Recommendation to receive and file Superintendent’s Update on department business.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  26-54832  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees; discuss
  anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate, take action to
  dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Advisory Commission on Aging on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT
